channel.title: Governance Digest
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Security Council Membership Rotation - November 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: An announcement says Immunefi's representative on the Arbitrum Security Council, who left Immunefi, will keep serving in a personal capacity after 9 of 12 members voted to allow it.

item.title: Node Operator Admission: Galaxy Digital as stVault Professional Operator (lido)
item.description: Galaxy Digital applies to join Lido as an stVaults Professional Operator, citing existing client requests and a first stVault targeted for end of 2026 or early Q1 2027.

item.title: Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Soneium Mainnet Proposer Rotation and Fee Vault Config Update (optimism)
item.description: A maintenance upgrade proposal would rotate the Soneium dispute game proposer to OP Enterprise and repoint two fee vaults to its cost recipient, as Soneium's operator moves from Sony to the Optimism Foundation.

item.title: Arbitrum Audit Program: Q4 & Final Transparency Report (arbitrum)
item.description: The final report on the DAO-approved Arbitrum Audit Program says 367 applications led to 25 audits for 22 projects, at a total audit expenditure of $1,477,810.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.09 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends lowering most supply and borrow caps across Aave V3 instances, and raising one: the USD₮0 borrow cap on Arbitrum from 45M to 52.4M.

item.title: [Constitutional] AIP: Approve Release of Frozen ETH and ARB (arbitrum)
item.description: Binance asks ArbitrumDAO to approve releasing 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB, frozen by the Arbitrum Security Council on 29 October 2026, back to a Binance recovery address.

item.title: SAEP-25: Update the Allocation System Primitive (sky)
item.description: Phoenix Labs proposes SAEP-25 to update the Allocation System Primitive section of the Spark Artifact, recording wound-down instances, rate limit IDs and current controllers.

item.title: [November 19, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell (sky)
item.description: Proposed changes for the Spark spell of November 19, 2026: seven changes across Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Unichain, Avalanche and X-Layer, including deprecating Spark Liquidity Layer on OP Mainnet, Unichain and Avalanche, and December grants of 865,000 USDS and 45,000 USDS.

item.title: ACLManager: RISK_ADMIN_ROLE grants, Sep 2026 — decoded (aave)
item.description: A forum post decodes three RISK_ADMIN_ROLE grants on Aave V3 Ethereum since 2 September 2026, all sent by the governance Executor, and notes the role can change caps and risk parameters without a full vote.

item.title: Request: wallet list behind the Aave Insights treasury figure (aave)
item.description: An independent treasury analysis service asks TokenLogic for the wallet list and method behind the Aave Insights treasury figure ($260.65M at Q3 2026 close) so it can reconcile its own numbers.

item.title: Per-Asset Liquidation Thresholds Underpredict Co-Liquidation by 301× (aave)
item.description: A forum post reports a backtest finding that Aave V3 per-asset liquidation thresholds do not account for assets falling together, and argues for a joint probability model.

item.title: [TEMP CHECK] AAVE SECURITY SHIELD – Exploring Preventive Risk Controls for External Security Incidents (aave)
item.description: A community initiative (written in Spanish) proposes studying whether Aave could temporarily limit new debt during an external security incident while keeping repayments and liquidations working. It asks for a feasibility study, not protocol changes.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.08 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the USDC borrow cap on Aave V3 Core from 2.6B to 2.75B and the USDe supply cap from 550M to 750M, after both reserves reached near-full utilization.

item.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-09 (sky)
item.description: Core GovOps submits the weekly Atlas Edit proposal for the week of 2026-11-09: edits include adding weETH as Morpho vault collateral with a 60,000 weETH cap, new Morpho vault governance rules, and monthly grants to the Spark and Grove foundations.

item.title: OpCo Update October 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: OpCo reports on October 2026 for Arbitrum DAO, covering the Oversight and Transparency Committee, USDG coordination, a negotiation over a 10M ARB set-aside, and cross-organization work.

item.title: [RFC] Upgrade VolatilePair hook and update X Layer releaser (uniswap)
item.description: Uniswap Labs proposes an RFC with two technical updates: upgrading the VolatilePair hook on Ethereum to cap its temporary fee by block gap, and updating the protocol fee releaser on X Layer.

item.title: [TEMP CHECK] Extend HyperLend's Friendly Fork Recognition to Elysium (Aave v3.7) (aave)
item.description: HyperLend asks the Aave DAO to recognize its deployment on Elysium (an L2 for the Hyperliquid ecosystem) as a friendly fork on Aave v3.7, offering 50% of that deployment's revenue to the DAO.

item.title: Entropy Advisors Monthly Update: October 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: Entropy Advisors reports on October 2026 for Arbitrum DAO: USDG supply on Arbitrum One reached $61.32M, treasury stablecoins moved toward USDG, and two onchain votes close November 12.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.06 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends a broad set of borrow and supply cap changes across Aave V3 instances, mostly reductions, plus a USDe base borrow rate increase to 7.00%. USDt on Avalanche had reached 99.9% borrow cap utilization.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.06 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising several supply, draw and add caps and one base interest rate on Aave V4 reserves on Ethereum, Avalanche and Base. The post is a risk-steward parameter update based on observed borrowing and liquidity.

item.title: Compound Foundation: Monthly V4 Programme Update [October 2026] (compound)
item.description: The Compound Foundation's fifth monthly V4 funding-program update reports an on-track status, new engineering hires and lower proposed annual provider fees.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.03 (aave)
item.description: A risk service provider recommends raising several supply and borrow caps on Aave V4 (Ethereum and Avalanche) and changing the USDC interest rate slope on two hubs.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.03 (aave)
item.description: A risk service provider recommends doubling the USD₮0 borrow cap on Aave V3 X Layer and cutting the WAVAX supply cap on Aave V3 Avalanche.

item.title: [Final Report] zkArb SDK - Dev Tooling on One and Stylus (D.A.O. Season 3) (arbitrum)
item.description: The zkArb SDK grantee reports all seven milestones delivered under a $13,000 Arbitrum D.A.O. Season 3 grant.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.02 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising three Aave V3 caps: USDe supply on X Layer, USDT0 borrow on Monad, and WETH borrow on Optimism, via the Risk Steward process.

item.title: PSM-GUSD-A and PSM-PAX-A housekeeping (sky)
item.description: Sidestream proposes a core spell to fully offboard two inactive legacy PSM collateral types (PSM-GUSD-A and PSM-PAX-A) from Sky's on-chain records.

item.title: Rewarding Active Delegates - October 2026 Results (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's October 2026 delegate rewards: 28 of 32 enrolled delegates qualified and $12,000 was distributed, with 86.72% aggregate participation.

item.title: November 3, 2026 - Open Discussion of Proposals Governance Call (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's governance call on November 3, 16:00-17:00 UTC, will cover three on-chain AIPs, an off-chain Stylus Activation Contract AIP, and a Security Council emergency action.

item.title: 2 November, 2026 - Roundup of Active/Upcoming Votes (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's roundup lists on-chain votes including a 100M ARB addition to the DRIP budget for USDG adoption and a 1,800 ETH treasury transfer.

item.title: Risk Month in Review: October 2026 (sky)
item.description: BA Labs' October report covers a Stability Scope parameter change, stUSDS keeper rate settings and Treasury Management Function figures for the Sky Ecosystem.

item.title: AL Development Update | October 2026 (aave)
item.description: Aave Labs' October update reports Aave V4 deposits above $1.5B, the first external curator on V4, and an ARFC to establish the Aave Foundation.

item.title: Mosaico Delegate Platform (compound)
item.description: Mosaico, an advisory firm continuing the Avantgarde Finance delegate work, has posted a delegate platform for Compound governance.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Add Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.11.01 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising the Aave V4 add cap for weETH on Ethereum from 20K to 22K and for GOOGLc on Base from 15K to 22K.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.01 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising borrow caps on five Aave V3 reserves whose debt has reached 98.3% to 100% of caps reduced on October 30.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Slope2 Increases on Aave V3 and Aave V4 / 2026.10.31 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends restoring Slope2 (the borrow rate slope above optimal utilization) on affected Aave V3 and V4 reserves to pre-incident values, now that the reserves are no longer frozen.

item.title: ENS DAO Newsletter #123 - 11/1/2026 (ens)
item.description: ENS newsletter lists ENSv2 activation as executed, a Meta-Governance Working Group Term 7 funding request of 201,559 USDC as passed, and new draft IPS amendments and ENSv2 pricing temp checks.

item.title: Proposal Guardian: Cancellation of Proposal 619 (compound)
item.description: The Community Multisig, acting as Compound's Proposal Guardian, says it cancelled Proposal 619 before execution.

item.title: [Gauntlet] tBTC Risk Parameter Update: Supply Caps and Borrow Collateral Factors to 0 (compound)
item.description: Gauntlet recommends setting the tBTC supply cap and borrow collateral factor to 0 on every Compound Comet where tBTC is listed, after Threshold Network paused tBTC minting and redemptions.

item.title: tBTC Mint & Redeem Pause: Aave's Response (aave)
item.description: After Threshold Network paused tBTC mints and redeems, the guardian multisig froze tBTC on Aave V3 Ethereum Core, stopping new deposits and borrowing against it.

item.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-02 (sky)
item.description: Core GovOps submits this week's Atlas edits, including temporary capital ratio requirements and a larger exposure limit for Osero's Gauntlet USDC vault instance.

item.title: Notice of amendment to Bylaw 16 (annual and interim budgets) (ens)
item.description: The ENS Foundation Board amended Bylaw 16 to set an annual budget deadline and allow a capped interim budget; no tokenholder vote is required and it takes effect 7 November 2026.

item.title: [Gauntlet] Deprecation of the Ethereum WBTC Comet (compound)
item.description: Gauntlet recommends winding down the Ethereum WBTC Comet by setting borrow collateral factors and the remaining supply caps to zero, citing minimal borrow demand.

item.title: ENS-budget: budget-first ENS v2 renewals for viem (ens)
item.description: A community developer announced ens-budget, a small TypeScript library for ENS v2 renewals that finds the longest renewal a stablecoin budget buys.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow and Draw Cap Reductions on Aave V3 and Aave V4 / 2026.10.30 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends cutting borrow caps on the largest Aave V3 reserves and draw caps on the largest V4 credit lines to about 2% above the amount borrowed before the exploit.

item.title: Security Council Emergency Action – 30/10/2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: The Arbitrum Security Council executed an emergency action on 30 October 2026 to freeze 8,425 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB on Arbitrum One held by an address identified with a Binance exploit.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Temporary Slope2 Reductions on Aave V3 and Aave V4 / 2026.10.30 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends temporarily lowering Slope2 on stablecoin reserves (and V4 Ethereum WETH) so borrow rates at full utilization stay at or below 10% APR after the reserve freeze.

item.title: Binance Hot Wallet Exploit: Aave's Response (aave)
item.description: Aave contributors describe their response to a reported Binance hot wallet exploit, including freezing reserves across Aave V3 and V4 networks.

item.title: Compound V3: Supply Paused Across Major Markets (compound)
item.description: Compound announced that supply is paused on all major Compound V3 markets across Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Base because of an ongoing incident on Ethereum mainnet.

item.title: [Constitutional] AIP: Stylus Activation Contract (arbitrum)
item.description: A Constitutional AIP would resume Stylus contract activations on Arbitrum One with a new activation contract, delegating activation signatures to an Arbitrum Foundation multisig for contracts that pass a limited security audit.

item.title: Institutional Comet: Update on proposed council architecture and migration (compound)
item.description: An interim update proposes a council architecture and five-step migration to place Compound's Institutional Comet under Compound governance with a delegated process for market changes.
